---
title: Align country names across international datasets
---

## Question

How can country and region names be reconciled across international health and development datasets?

## Data

World Bank country metadata and WHO country dimension values loaded from stable public APIs and cached in `data-raw/`.

## Linkage strategy

Use exact ISO codes where possible, then resolve residual name variants with string distance and a small adjudication table.

## Result

The walkthrough surfaces common issues such as historical names, territories, and punctuation differences.

## Reporting

State how unmatched territories and aggregate regions were handled, because those choices directly affect denominator comparability.
